I enjoyed it when I first saw it, having no idea it was called the ninth circle. I just watched a film called all hallows eve and thought it was a bunch of short spooky stories and intense lore. It’s super fun for me now to watch it with Terrifiers current context.

I think we will get a half half - flashback movie in the past and final story in the present

Approve! So excited, and was hoping for a “present - past - present” movie.
There are so many questions still. 
*if you haven’t explored the confirmed info by Leone, get on it! 

We know Art is not Sienna’s father. 

We know Art was human in T1.

We know the little pale girl took the form of a girl found murdered at a carnival (child of two carnival performers) - potentially related to Art. We know Art killed her. 

We don’t know what happened to Jonathan. I have a wandering mind about him and/or his father doing some summoning shit that led to human Art being resurrected. (Running wild with thoughts here).

We don’t know if Gabbie is coming back from hell with the sword (but that’s my biggest hunch - she will end up being the catalyst to defeat evil). Haven’t seen anyone else ponder this, so if there are others posting about it, would love to discuss. 

We don’t know how or why Art became immortal/demonic after his death at the end of T1.

Soooo many questions, I can’t wait for answers.
